public_rationale: The antecedent remains unestablished, so the conditional forecast cannot be scored. Block's announced workforce reduction illustrates that large AI-associated cuts can accompany an adoption strategy; it does not establish losses caused by a bubble implosion. Counting such cuts toward this forecast would change the causal claim. This is not a finding that the feared outcome is false.
limitations: The claim's antecedent and industry-wide harm are loosely defined.
The threshold of 20,000 is an evaluator interpretation.
Announced reductions are not automatically realized job losses.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: He fears that if the AI bubble implodes, whether big backers wind down their positions or cannibalize their companies, tens of thousands of people will lose their jobs and much of the tech industry will suffer.
conditions: whether Microsoft and Google wind down positions or cannibalize their companies

statement.excerpt: I fear tens of thousands of people will lose their jobs, and much of the tech industry will suffer as they realize that the only thing that can grow forever is cancer.

from_speaker: potential human cost of an AI bubble implosion
I fear tens of thousands of people will lose their jobs
much of the tech industry will suffer
our_interpretation: The surrounding passage makes an AI bubble implosion the antecedent of the forecast.
The alternatives concerning backers describe possible routes, not two conditions that must both occur.
Tens of thousands is read as at least 20,000 job losses attributable to the implosion, without imposing an upper limit.
Much of the tech industry requires harm across multiple substantial parts of the industry, not one employer.
I fear expresses uncertainty, but the passage still presents a conditional outcome that can be investigated.
Job losses caused by successful automation or increased AI investment do not alone establish losses caused by an AI bubble implosion.
criteria.support_condition: After a documented broad AI bubble implosion, credible records attribute at least 20,000 job losses to it and establish widespread tech-industry harm.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the antecedent occurs, a sufficiently complete account of the implosion and its aftermath establishes that the predicted employment scale or widespread industry harm did not occur.
